description:
Taeho, who is a ‘perfumer’, has been dating Sunhye for seven years. He felt that their relationship was stuck in a rut and needed some change to spice thibgs up. One day, his best friend accidentally spilled a new perfume on Taeho and that night he realised that she couldn’t resist him because of this powerful new scent. With the creation of this new perfume, Taeho quickly runs to his best friend and asks him to seduce her, so that he is able to make his NTR fantasy become a reality. “I want you… to seduce her.”
